coordination.selection: first registered pair, H5; no best-case selection
coordination.decomposition: base changes first at q0, then arm changes at current base; exact telescoping FK difference

horizon.command_difference_definition: max over six joints of absolute difference between adjacent solver request_body outputs; no division by dt; rad/s
horizon.reversal_definition: within phase, both adjacent commands abs > 0.05 rad/s and opposite signs; sum over six joints divided by window duration
horizon.window_definition: first solver cycle through solver stop after retreat; excludes entry navigation, unfolding, stowing and return
horizon.scope: three paired archived drawer experiments; solver.N is only configuration difference, but changes cost accumulation and terminal placement

strategy.time_basis: simulation clock; first navigation-plan publication to independent terminal completion
strategy.scope: whole-strategy comparison, not isolated base motion; alternating order M-H, H-M, M-H
